title: Analysis of the Crystallographic Orientation at the Interface Between Carbon Nanotubes and Magnesium Alloy Matrix
content: Carbon nanotubes (CNTs) have been studied as potential reinforcements for Metal Matrix Composites (MMCs) to enhance mechanical properties [1]. These materials have been extensively investigated in transportation-related technologies, particularly in the automotive, aeronautical, and aerospace sectors [2]. Additionally, significant progress has been made in other sectors, such as the biomedical and electronics industries [3].
